name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.171.0 — Review close no longer deletes tests. Close-time expiry stays classification-only — it still counts born/kept/retired onto the review row and names what is retirable — but writes nothing to the tree and makes no commit; the deliberate 'test-expiry --all-done --apply' sweep is now the only path that deletes a test. The classifier's two fail-safe holes are repaired in the same landing: a 'superseded' owner spec counts as closed alongside 'done', and an unreadable spec file under specs/ keeps every test citing its derived AC-ID prefix, warning once on stderr instead of silently letting a collided ID fall open. 7.170.0 — The design stage prints the work, not the inventory. `design-atlas.js check` collapses its advisory warn lines to one `⚠️ <n> warn(s) — --verbose to list` count and omits the per-screen kit/bespoke breakdown, keeping the running unabsorbed total on every run; `mocks-driver.js notes open` collapses the answered-question history to a count and stops the journey-listed open notes after twenty with a `… <n> more open note(s)` tail. `--verbose` and `--all` restore the full pre-change output byte-for-byte, and no gate, refusal or served page changes behavior. 7.169.0 — A mock-page note can now mark an area: drag a rectangle over any part of a served mock and the note lands on that content at every viewport width, painted in its status colour by the notes layer. The box is stored as a fraction of the smallest element containing it with the covered children as the reflow fallback, so it re-finds its spot or honestly reports itself outdated and offers re-placement. The owner's card beside the box carries accept, reject with a reason, resolve, withdraw and delete behind an undoable toast.
